verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS issuing platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only a hosted, Adyen-operated service: cards are issued under Adyen's banking licenses and managed through its Customer Area and APIs. Receiving relayed authorisation webhooks on your own servers is an integration point, not self-hosting of the core product, and no self-hosted or on-prem deployment option is documented.
